summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Lumiere Gallery. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests pass covering admin auth, event CRUD (incl. threshold 50-100 validation), photo upload+indexing, indexing status, access grants (create/list/patch full_gallery_access/revoke), client OTP request+verify (dev_code), client events listing (grant-scoped), consent gate, selfie search (dedupe + My Photos upsert), full-gallery access enforcement, image serving with Bearer + ?token= (401 unauth), face-data deletion. Frontend: end-to-end mobile web flow verified — landing -> admin sign-in -> dashboard -> create event -> Photos/Access/Settings tabs (grant added, threshold saved) -> client sign-out; then landing -> client OTP request -> verify with dev_code -> client events (empty state). Minor RN-web warnings observed (invalid Ionicons name 'graduation-cap', deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents props) — non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid Ionicons name 'graduation-cap' produces repeated console warnings on category dropdowns/badges. Ionicons has no 'graduation-cap' glyph. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:43

issues: In screenshots of the Access/Settings tabs, the tab labels (Photos/Access/Settings) appear partially covered by the 'Access granted' / 'Event created' toast banner. The banner overlaps the tab strip momentarily — consider positioning the toast below the tab bar or animating it above the header so it doesn't obscure navigation controls.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. These are React Native Web deprecation warnings triggered by third-party or app styles. Non-blocking but should be addressed for future RN versions.

action_items: Replace 'graduation-cap' in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:43 with a valid Ionicons name (e.g. 'school' or 'school-outline') to remove console warnings.
(Optional polish) Position success/error toasts so they do not overlap the Photos/Access/Settings segmented control on the admin event screen.
(Optional) Migrate legacy shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~850 lines and mixes auth, events, photos, access, client, and file-serving concerns. Consider splitting into routers (auth_router, events_router, client_router, files_router) for maintainability once above 700 LOC.

In /api/events PATCH, similarity_threshold=0 would be silently dropped by 'v is not None' filter combined with truthiness elsewhere — currently benign because 0 fails the 50-100 range check, but ensure future fields relying on falsy values (e.g. False booleans) use explicit set semantics.
public_event() intentionally strips 'created_by' and 'collection_id' from responses (good, no ObjectId leakage). No _id leakage detected in any endpoint sampled.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (landing, admin login, dashboard, create event, Access grant, Settings threshold save, client OTP request/verify, client events)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed events, throwaway admin accounts, and ui_test_guest@example.com grants inside the test event. No production data touched. Face data deletion tested against event-scoped albums only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Seeded admin admin@lumiere.studio / Admin@12345. Client OTP dev_code returned in POST /api/auth/client/request-otp response (OTP_DEV_MODE=true). Pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_lumiere_gallery.py — safe to re-run. Selfie camera capture is not exercisable via headless browser (getUserMedia); the /search endpoint is exercised via multipart JPEG in pytest. MockFaceEngine is deterministic per (user_id, event_id) so retries produce consistent match counts.
rca_of_issue: No unresolved issue. Two intermittent pytest failures during initial run were due to pytest-xdist parallelization racing between workers (TestFileServing and TestFullGalleryAccess ran before their prerequisite uploads/grant-patches on the sibling worker). Fixed by making those test classes self-provision (own upload + explicit re-patch) so tests are independent of ordering.
